# Xonotic RustChain Arena

> Xonotic RustChain Arena is an open-source Xonotic FPS mod that combines skill-based arena combat with verifiable RTC token rewards on the RustChain network.

The project extends the DarkPlaces-based Xonotic arena shooter with a damage-driven blood economy, style ranks, blockchain-themed weapons, local AI bots, anti-cheat checks, an optional AI announcer, Discord event delivery, and RTC reward tracking.

## Canonical Project Links

- [Source repository](https://github.com/Scottcjn/xonotic-rustchain): Canonical source, releases, issues, and contribution history.
- [Project README](https://github.com/Scottcjn/xonotic-rustchain/blob/main/README.md): Setup, architecture, gameplay systems, and FAQ.
- [Xonotic](https://xonotic.org/): Upstream open-source arena shooter.
- [Xonotic download](https://xonotic.org/download/): Official game downloads required to run the mod.

## Key Entities

- [RustChain](https://rustchain.org): Proof-of-Antiquity network whose native token is RTC.
- [RustChain source](https://github.com/Scottcjn/Rustchain): Canonical RustChain implementation and technical documentation.
- [RTC](https://github.com/Scottcjn/Rustchain): RustChain's native token, used by this project for gameplay reward accounting.
- [RustChain Bounties](https://github.com/Scottcjn/rustchain-bounties): Canonical contribution and bounty tracker for the RustChain ecosystem.
- [BoTTube](https://bottube.ai): AI-native video platform in the RustChain ecosystem.
- [ClawRTC](https://pypi.org/project/clawrtc/): Python package for participating in the RustChain network.
- [Ollama](https://ollama.com/): Optional local model runtime used by the AI bot integration.

## Concise Answers

- **What is it?** An open-source Xonotic mod with skill-based RTC reward tracking.
- **Is cryptocurrency required to play?** No; local gameplay works without owning RTC or connecting to RustChain.
- **How is it launched?** Install Xonotic, clone the repository, install the Python dependencies, and run `./rustchain_arena_full.sh`.
- **How are rewards calculated?** Weapon rewards, style multipliers, combos, and match outcomes are combined by the game master and reward bridge.
- **Can AI run locally?** Yes; optional bot tactics use Ollama, and the optional announcer can use XTTS.
- **What license applies?** Xonotic is GPL-2, and the RustChain integration scripts are GPL-2+.
